components.name: Card
components.description: `Card` is the first compound API in `libs/ui`. Every other component here flattens to a single function — even ones with a Base UI primitive underneath that is itself namespaced (`Switch` wraps `Switch.Root` / `Switch.Thumb` into one component). Card has no Base UI primitive at all — there is no accessible "card" role, so nothing is lost by not flattening it — and Soma's own sheet already models it as independent regions (a header with an optional trailing action, a body slot, an optional footer), not a fixed set of props. Exposing `Card.Root` / `Card.Header` / `Card.HeaderTitle` / `Card.Body` / `Card.Footer` as parts lets a consumer:
